source: Dictionary headwords plus English Wiktionary tables via Kaikki
policy: Only existing dictionary infinitives marked as verbs are admitted. Forms are generated using explicit vowel-harmony and inflection rules, with source-supported stem alternations and compound auxiliary profiles. A cell is marked documented only when its exact string matches the corresponding source-table tags; all other cells are labeled rule-generated. These are standard form families, not a claim to exhaust every voice, dialect, register or possible combination. Original headwords and grammar archives are untouched.
editorial_notes: The defective copula imək is kept searchable but excluded from ordinary rule generation. Compound stems follow their lexical auxiliary profile, avoiding malformed whole-phrase source tables.
Standard negative indefinite future uses -maz/-məz in second/third persons and -mar/-mər in first persons; incorrect source-template r in second-person forms is not copied.
Source future-participle spellings ending in back-vowel -acak are not copied; standard Azerbaijani uses -acaq.
Analytic ability uses -a/-ə bilmək, including its negative forms.
Additional dictionary-listed causative t/d profiles are recorded in scripts/conjugation-stem-review.json. Their cells remain labeled generated unless independently found in the source table.
atlas_coverage: The picker uses the current map’s verified verbal infinitives, including entries added after the source-table snapshot. Azerbaijani source labels and documented word-formation rules establish verb status. New forms are labeled rule-generated where a matching table is unavailable.
english_form_meanings: English phrases follow the selected person, tense and polarity. Reviewed English readings take precedence, and an existing verbal dictionary gloss supplies a base where there is no separate reviewed profile.
